MediaTek Dimensity 9300

  • GPU: Mali-G720 Immortalis MP12
  • Cores: 8
  • Clock: 3250 MHz
MediaTek Dimensity 9300 – an 8-core chipset that was announced on November 6, 2023, and is manufactured using a 4-nanometer process technology. It has 1 core Cortex-X4 at 3250 MHz, 3 cores Cortex-X4 at 2850 MHz, and 4 cores Cortex-A720 at 2000 MHz.

You have seen this with laptops with AMD for a while, AMD laptop CPUs are usually as fast or better than their intel equivalent but much more efficient in terms of heat and battery life than intel. but the problem is the CPUs are not produced in high enough volume so it is quite hard to get a high end AMD laptop. I suspect the same thing is happening with Mediatek as they are still smaller and are growing so cannot afford the big $$$ for fab capacity at TSMC or to make assurances to phone makers to supply their flagships, gaming phones, flagship killer etc with these chips. And its a shame because even though Qualcomm has got their act together with making good socs again since the 8+Gen 1 and particularly the 8 Gen 2 and 3, the Dimensity 9200 and 9300 seem amazing in performance and efficiency and it would be great to see them in more high end phones. Or for that matter the 9400, 9500 etc. But they have to compete with Qualcomm's custom "Nuvia" cores by that point

The GPU is not "Mali," but "Immortalis;" these two GPUs are distinctly different. Mali does not support Ray Tracing, while Immortalis does. The Dimensity 9300 uses the "Arm Immortalis-G720" GPU, which boasts the "Arm 5th Gen" architecture.
